title: 销量
question: 今年上半年各品类销量排行
sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS items_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  items_sold DESC,
  category
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS items_sold
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_id,
    line_amount,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price
  FROM order_items
) AS oi
JOIN (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit_cost,
    unit_price
  FROM products
) AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

  p.category
